name: xodus-nexus
description: Xbox-inspired Microsoft Store game launcher for Linux
author: Thri11ride

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 ELECTRON_OZONE_PLATFORM_HINT=x11 electron . --ozone-platform=x11 --disable-gpu
scripts.test:runtime-tools: node --test scripts/eac-trace-summary.test.mjs scripts/wine-exception-metadata.test.mjs scripts/assemble-shared-runtime.test.mjs scripts/build-runtime-dxvk.test.mjs scripts/verify-runtime-base.test.mjs scripts/runtime-compat/staging.test.mjs scripts/runtime-tests/build-store-probes.test.mjs scripts/runtime-tests/build-user-privilege-probe.test.mjs scripts/runtime-tests/build-gamesave-sync-probe.test.mjs scripts/runtime-tests/build-user-audio-probe.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run test && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.dist:flatpak: npm run build && electron-builder --linux flatpak --publish never
scripts.pack: npm run build && electron-builder --linux dir --publish never
